# Malene Tousgaard Foget Østergaard

Malene Tousgaard Foget Østergaard is a Kvalitetskonsulent (quality consultant) affiliated with [[rkkp|RKKP]] (Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram), where she serves as the contact person for the [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-databasen]][^src1]. She is identified in RKKP's Afdeling for psykiatri, gynækologi-obstetrik og kroniske sygdomme[^src1], and elsewhere within the organization as a quality consultant in Afdeling 3 of RKKP's Videncenter, where she is described as the contact person and representative of the data-responsible authority ("dataansvarlig myndighed")[^src2].

Her role places her at the administrative core of the ADHD-databasen, a Danish health database that monitors the quality of assessment and treatment of ADHD in children and adolescents under 18 years of age, as documented in the ADHD-DATABASEN annual report covering the period 1 April 2023 to 31 March 2024. That report was produced by RKKP and administered by a chairmanship of senior consultants (overlæger) from Aarhus Universitetshospital and DPS Midtjylland, and it highlights significant challenges facing Danish child and adolescent psychiatry, including rising referral numbers, longer waiting times, and declining achievement of quality targets on most indicators. As the database's designated contact person, Østergaard sits within this broader institutional structure connecting RKKP's quality-improvement apparatus to the clinical governance of ADHD care in Denmark.
